positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote web app to run in-house system installations (Next.js, Typescript, Redux)
• Trained and deployed ML algorithm for license plate object-detection (YOLOv5, PyTorch, Seldon)
• Migrated repos from Jenkins CI to GitLab CI, updated Helm Charts; debugged issues on Kubernetes
• Developed real-time web app plugins for WebTAK, a geospatial collaboration platform (React)
• Designed and built Java RESTful APIs that served mission planning data for electronic warfare

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built messaging platform for brokers and asset managers (AngularJS, Javascript, SQL, C#)
• Created database objects like tables, indexes, stored procedures and triggers (SSMS)
• Supported live operations by pushing new versions and hot-fixes to production environment (TeamCity)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote proof of concept software pll for demodulating NTSC color TV signals from raw I/Q data to produce color rastering (C++, Matlab)
• Built C# application for demodulating bluetooth, wifi and zigbee signals 
• Implemented data analysis tool for analyzing RF signals (Javascript, SQL, C#)
• Lab test equipment: spectrum analyzers, signal generators and oscilloscopes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote C/C++11 code for software library compatible with MPI (Message Passing Interface) to support fault recovery without application shutdown
• Developed functional and unit tests to ensure quality

PI: Keita Teranishi, PhD, Principal Member of Technical Staff, SNL

positions.title: Peer-Led Team Leader
positions.description:
• Coordinated and ran workshops for undergraduates in assembly and object oriented design
• Helped further students understanding of software related concepts and programming projects
• Supported material including: Object Oriented/ADT Java, Assembly and C

positions.title: NSF Research Intern
positions.description:
• Successfully ported C++ source code to a hybrid CPU/GPU architecture using CUDA
• Achieved a 5x speedup over serial CPU run implementation 
• Scheduled big data testing using Bash and custom configuration files

Client: Jerimy Polf, PhD, Department of Radiation Oncology, University of Maryland School of Medicine

PI: Matthias Gobbert, PhD, Department of Mathematics and Statistics, UMBC

company.name: University of Maryland, Baltimore County, Computer Science

positions.title: NSF Research Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented parallel architectures in C using OpenMP threading to speedup hash calculations
• Qualified in ACM Student Research Competition for Supercomputing Conference 2014

PI: Yong Chen, PhD, Computer Science Department, TTU
